newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela state electric company saddled with debt.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela state electric company saddled with debt.

text.p: Venezuela's largest electricity generation and distribution company, state-owned Cadafe, is saddled with debts that dwarf its revenues and retard plans to privatize the company, a top government official said Thursday.
Cadafe's debts of $1.5 billion "are 40 times higher than the total annual billing of Cadafe for power sales," Venezuelan Investment Fund (FIV) President Alberto Poletto said in Congress.
Low tariffs and the failure of public sector clients to pay their bills led Cadafe to a precarious financial state, said Poletto who runs the state body in charge of privatization.
About 30 percent of Cadafe's bills are sent to state organizations and 90 percent of those bills are overdue.
"Privatization implies paying bills and raising tariffs," he said.
